A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = 'Beta<a href="https://example.com"><br>Alpha</a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
